purpose: Teach: 履き/怪しげ/一人前/ありゃ/競う/似合わ/着々と/とてつもなく

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、新しいスニーカーを履きましょうね
lines.en: Sho, you should wear those new sneakers.
lines.style: Gentle suggestion, warm and present. Soft opening, unhurried pace. A small smile in the voice — the kind of care that doesn't need fanfare.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、公園で怪しげな影を見たよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I saw something weird in the park earlier.
lines.style: Quiet urgency underneath. Not alarmed, but genuinely trying to share something that bothered him. Watching her face to see if she thinks it matters.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お絵描きでも一人前になれるわよ
lines.en: Sho, you're getting really good at drawing, you know.
lines.style: Warm conviction without condescension. Light emphasis on the progress itself — this isn't flattery, it's observation. Steady, believing tone.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ありゃ、お絵描き道具忘れちゃった
lines.en: Mei-sis, oh — I forgot my art supplies.
lines.style: Self-directed wry humor, small and genuine. Slight embarrassment softened by acceptance. Not looking for rescue, just stating the fact.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お友達と絵を競うのは楽しいわね
lines.en: Sho, drawing with your friends is so much fun, isn't it?
lines.style: Reflective and warm. Opening with gentle curiosity, not assertion. Slight trailing-off — inviting him to agree, not demanding it. Noticing what he enjoys.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、この絵がぼくに似合わなくない?
lines.en: Mei-sis, doesn't this drawing look like me?
lines.style: Tentative and thoughtful. Small vulnerability — genuinely asking, not fishing. Watching closely for her answer. The question of a child who notices details and wonders if he's seeing them right.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さんの絵は、着々と上達してるのよ
lines.en: Sho, my drawings are getting better all the time.
lines.style: Quiet pride and gentle self-acknowledgment. Steady, matter-of-fact tone — not bragging, just stating something she's noticed about herself. A small anchor of self-trust.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、メイ姉さんの絵はとてつもなく素敵だね
lines.style: Genuine admiration, freely given. Small and sincere — not performing praise, just offering what he truly sees. Direct eye contact in his voice. Unhesitating.
